caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, lidded urn or trophy cup made in a realistic, detailed black-and-white pencil style on a plain, light background. The urn has a tall, rounded body that tapers into a slender stem and rests on a square plinth base with a beaded edge. The lid is domed and topped with a small finial. The body of the urn features a reflective surface and, at its center, an ornate script monogram is visible. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a close-up of the same monogram enclosed in a square border. Towards the bottom right of the drawing, the artist’s name, Aaron Fastovsky, is inscribed. The overall color of the drawing is grayscale, with various tonal shading used to indicate the urn's form and reflective qualities.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
